tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Tests, exe and installer into dist\

tasks.label: Reinstall
tasks.detail: Build, run the installer silently, and copy speak.ps1 into ~/.claude/tts
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $setup = Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}\dist\ClaudeCodeTTS-Setup-*.exe' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1; Write-Host "Installing $($setup.Name)"; $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'claude-code-tts-setup.log'; $p = Start-Process $setup.FullName -ArgumentList '/VERYSILENT', '/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES', '/NORESTART', "/LOG=`"$log`"" -PassThru; $p.WaitForExit(); $exe = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Claude Code TTS\claude-code-tts.exe'; if ((Get-FileHash $exe).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash '${workspaceFolder}\dist\claude-code-tts.exe').Hash) { throw "Installed exe was not replaced. See $log" }; Write-Host 'Installed exe matches the build.'; $tts = Join-Path $HOME '.claude\tts'; if (Test-Path $tts) { Copy-Item '${workspaceFolder}\assets\speak.ps1' $tts; Write-Host "Copied speak.ps1 to $tts" } else { Write-Host 'No ~/.claude/tts yet: open the app and click Install / Repair.' }
